mapper.select: SELECT u.leader_id FROM idp_file f join user u on f.user_id = u.id and u.status = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} and f.status = 1 limit 1
SELECT u.leader_id, u.role, u.id as user_id FROM idp_file f join user u on f.user_id = u.id and u.status = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} and f.status != 4 limit 1
